test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the most appropriate meaning of the underlined phrase.

She knew that the best way to __get into hot water__ was to anger her boss.

options.text: To enter into a hot water pond

solution:
The correct answer is "**To get into trouble."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The phrase "to get into hot water" means to get into trouble or to be in a difficult situation.**
 
• मुसीबत में पड़ना या कठिन परिस्थिति में पड़ना।
 
• It is an idiom that is commonly used in English language.
 
• The phrase is used metaphorically, as hot water is associated with discomfort and trouble.
 
 
• Example: If you don't finish your homework, you will get into hot water.
 
 
 
• Thus, among the given options, option 4 explains the underlined phrase appropriately.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.
